# StorageBlue Growth Fund, LP

> A $350M institutional self-storage investment fund with $1B in buying power, backed by 35+ years of proven performance developing and operating self-storage facilities in the New York and New Jersey metropolitan area.

StorageBlue Capital Management LLC is the manager of the StorageBlue Growth Fund, LP (SBGF), founded by Alan Mruvka — the founder of E! Entertainment Television. The fund invests in self-storage acquisitions, developments, and value-add redevelopment projects across high-barrier, underserved U.S. markets, starting in the NYC/NJ metro before expanding nationally.

## Key Facts

- **Fund size:** $350 million equity
- **Buying power:** Up to $1 billion via vertical integration
- **Track record:** 25 NYC/NJ facilities developed, 3.5M+ sq ft
- **Recent exit:** 6-facility portfolio sold for $100M (33.79% avg levered IRR, 17.14% unlevered IRR)
- **Investment horizon:** 5 years
- **Founded:** 2025

## Leadership

- **Alan Mruvka** — Founder & CEO. Founder of E! Entertainment Television, 35+ years in real estate and self-storage.
- **Winston Ma, CFA, Esq.** — Chief Investment Officer. Former Managing Director at China Investment Corporation ($1.2T AUM sovereign wealth fund).
